title: On Waiting for three hours in the rain
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：wait　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wait 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the headmaster ① waited for three hours in the rain without complaint, and every student in the school said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the headmaster ② waits for three hours in the rain with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ wait for three hours in the rain at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ waited for three hours in the rain before — a line in the record for October 1977 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Waiting for three hours in the rain without complaint, the headmaster said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ wait until the last boat came in with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Wait until the last boat came in at once and never mention it again.

By 1990 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new student from the next school ⑧ waits until the last boat came in without complaint every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ waited for three hours in the rain again when nobody else would.

⑩ To wait for three hours in the rain, my mother said in 1995, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the school remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the school forgets, somebody waits for three hours in the rain with great care again and somebody must wait for three hours in the rain without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 等候（一般过去式 waited for three hours in the rain：1983 年校长头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 等候（一般现在 waits for three hours in the rain：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 等候（不定式 to wait for three hours in the rain：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 等候（过去完成时 had waited for three hours in the rain：1977 年十月的学籍册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 等候（动名词 waiting for three hours in the rain 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 等待（wait until the last boat came in：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去等待一直等到最后一条船进港）
G. v. 等待（wait until the last boat came in：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 等候（后段两处：新来的学生照例 waits until the last boat came in，而母亲又一次 waited for three hours in the rain）

answers.why: wait 意为“等候”，1983 年校长毫无怨言地等候在雨里等了三个钟头，那是学堂里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 waited。
wait 意为“等候”，自那以后校长小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 waits。
wait 意为“等候”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯等候在雨里等了三个钟头”，此处为不定式 to wait for three hours in the rain。
wait 意为“等候”，学籍册里 十月 那行字说明早在 1990 年之前就有人等候过，故用过去完成时 had waited。
wait 意为“等候”，校长说“等候在雨里等了三个钟头这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 waiting for three hours in the rain 作主语。
wait 意为“等待”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去等待一直等到最后一条船进港”，should ever 之后用原形 wait until the last boat came in。
wait 意为“等待”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻等待一直等到最后一条船进港（wait until the last boat came in at once），以后再也不要提起。
wait 意为“等候”，新来的学生每个学年都照例等待一直等到最后一条船进港，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 waits。
wait 意为“等候”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地等候在雨里等了三个钟头，用一般过去式 waited 叙述。
wait 意为“等候”，结尾那句是母亲 1995 年的话：要等候在雨里等了三个钟头，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和学堂记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 wait 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the headmaster waited for three hours in the rain without complaint, and nobody in the school forgot it.
Even now the headmaster waits for three hours in the rain with great care whenever the school asks.
Waiting for three hours in the rain without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever wait until the last boat came in with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new student from the next school waits until the last boat came in without complaint every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother waited for three hours in the rain again, and the school remembered that half.
